mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on future equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE falls below 4.4%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
